description: Swollen vascular tissue in the anal canal or around the anus.
symptoms: Bleeding with bowel movements may occur

appearance.general: External hemorrhoids may appear as tender lumps around the anus; internal hemorrhoids are not usually visible externally.

warning_signs: Heavy bleeding, severe pain, fever, or a rapidly enlarging painful lump requires medical assessment.
doctor_discussion_points: Discuss bleeding pattern, bowel habits, constipation, and whether another cause needs exclusion.
